description: Assertions for the Watchtower weekly content pipeline (steps 01-06). Derived from step SUCCESS METRICS and failures observed in W31 session.

assertions.description: outputs.dropped_as_continuing is present and is an integer
At least one theme promoted (weekly_themes array non-empty)
assertions.note: Zero is acceptable only when explicit no-themes reason is written to outputs

assertions.description: All paths in outputs.draft_paths have underscore-prefixed filename
Post title (# heading) in each draft uses Title Case — no all-lowercase or sentence-case titles
assertions.check: Each draft's H1 heading must capitalize all significant words. Articles (a, an, the), prepositions, and conjunctions under 4 chars may be lowercase unless first/last word.

assertions.description: Draft bodies contain no week-number references matching pattern W\d{2}
Each ## section header is immediately followed by a blank line before paragraph text
assertions.check: Scan each draft for ## headers. The line immediately after the header must be blank (empty line), not the start of a paragraph.

assertions.description: Tweet text <= 240 chars for every tweet where supporting_url is non-null
Tweet text <= 280 chars for every tweet where supporting_url is null
All non-null supporting_url values trace back to a URL in weekly_themes[].source_items
assertions.check: For each tweet with supporting_url != null, verify the URL appears in at least one source_items entry in accumulated-context.weekly_themes.

assertions.description: No curly/smart quote characters in any message sent to #content
Vault path line in each Slack message contains obsidian://open?vault=Obsidian&file= URI
Every draft in drafts_sent was confirmed via read.py before proceeding to next draft
assertions.check: Verify that read.py was called after each send and that the message ts appears in the response before the next send was initiated.

assertions.description: No draft appears in both drafts_sent and was sent more than once (no duplicate ts values in channel)
assertions.check: Review channel read.py output for duplicate message content within the session window.
